answer_1.quote: We introduce our approach called ENTRUST ... a method for argument reframing ... we fine-tune BART on our parallel data ... to generate reframed arguments.
answer_1.outputs: Reframed arguments (text) with altered connotation but preserved denotation

answer_2.quote: We calculate Semantic Similarity with our input using SENTENCE BERT(SBERT) ... we also calculate entailment scores of these outputs with the input argument respectively using a RoBERTa model fine-tuned on the Multi-NLI dataset.

answer_4.quote: We use Amazon Mechanical Turk to evaluate on a total of 900 utterances ... We proposed a set of 3 criteria to evaluate the generated output: (1) Fluency (F), (2) Meaning Preservation (M), (3) Trustworthiness/Presence of Fear (T/PF).
answer_4.guideline: Human raters were asked to rate each generated argument on Fluency, Meaning Preservation, Trustworthiness (for partisan) or Presence of Fear (for appeal-to-fear).
